verdict.rationale: Snowflake's SQL-centric architecture and CLI (snow sql headless execution, app/workload management, MCP server for agents) give strong evidence that most core operations (warehouses, RBAC, streams, data sharing, dbt, Cortex functions) are scriptable outside the UI, and probes confirm the CLI runs keylessly and can pipe SQL non-interactively. However, no public OpenAPI/REST spec was found (probe-2: all openapi.json paths 404), and UI-native experiences like Snowsight Notebooks, cost anomaly monitors, and semantic view visual authoring aren't shown to have documented API-only equivalents. Missing for 10: a discoverable unified REST/OpenAPI surface, explicit API parity for Snowsight-only features (notebooks, cost anomaly dashboards), and independent confirmation from developers that they can fully replace Snowsight with the CLI/API.
